name: Climb and Slide!
desc:
🎉 Welcome to Climb & Slide!

Get ready for an exciting challenge where you’ll climb towering structures and slide down at high speeds, all while avoiding tricky obstacles and collecting rewards along the way.
Start your journey by scaling iconic locations like the Beach, City, and more — then unlock community-made towers that keep the fun going!

Climb and slide your way to the top. 👑

How to Play:
🧗 Climb through challenges
💰 Collect coins
🐦 Unlock rides
🌍 Unlock maps

🔓 New Code: Release
👍 Join our group and like the game to get more updates!
